data.attribution: Wadden et al., Fact or Fiction: Verifying Scientific Claims, EMNLP 2020
data.recorded_here: claim ids, collection truth, evidence document ids with labels, and top-20 ranked document ids with scores; no claim or abstract text

parameters.audit: TF-IDF cosine at sentence level (title as a sentence), smooth IDF over sentences, document score = best sentence
parameters.tokenizer: lowercase alphanumeric runs, fixed English stopword list, no stemming
